def forward(self, x, context):
    a = torch.sin(x)
    b = torch.cos(a)
    c = torch.tanh(b)
    d = torch.relu(c)
    e = torch.sigmoid(d)
    f = torch.sin(e)
    g = torch.cos(f)
    h = torch.tanh(g)
    i = torch.relu(h)
    j = torch.sigmoid(i)
    return j + a + context
